# OBSBOT script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## obsbot.connect

Starts connecting to OBSBOT Center. Cuebot keeps trying in the background until it works.

**Gives back:** true once connecting has started.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.connect");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_connect()
    ```

## obsbot.disconnect

Disconnects Cuebot from OBSBOT Center.

**Gives back:** true when done.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.disconnect");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_disconnect()
    ```

## obsbot.getState

Asks your OBSBOT camera for its current settings, like zoom and where it is pointing.

**Gives back:** Values named obsbot.deviceIndex, obsbot.deviceName, obsbot.awake, obsbot.zoom, obsbot.fov, obsbot.pitch, obsbot.yaw, obsbot.aiLocked, obsbot.autoFraming, obsbot.deviceCount and obsbot.preset1.exists / .name (and 2, 3).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.getState");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_get_state()
    ```

## obsbot.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot can reach your OBSBOT camera (through OBSBOT Center) right now.

**Gives back:** true while OBSBOT Center answers, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_is_connected()
    ```

## obsbot.send

Sends any raw OSC message to OBSBOT Center. For advanced users who know OBSBOT's OSC addresses.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | `address` | The OSC address, like "/OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom". Needed. |
| `args` | `args` | Optional. A list of values to send with it, like [50]. |

**Gives back:** true when sent.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.send", new { address = "/OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom", args = new object?[] { 50 } });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_send(address="/OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom", args=[50])
    ```

## obsbot.setGimbal

Points your OBSBOT camera in a direction. Numbers past the camera's limit are cut down to the limit.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pan` | `pan` | Optional. Left/right in degrees, -129 to 129 (a Tail 2 reached directly: -159 to 159). Default 0 (straight ahead). |
| `pitch` | `pitch` | Optional. Up/down in degrees, -59 to 59 (a Tail 2 reached directly: -62 to 62). Default 0. |
| `speed` | `speed` | Optional. How fast it turns, 0 to 90. Default 50. |
| `device` | `device` | Optional. Which camera in OBSBOT Center, 1 to 4. Leave it out for the selected one. |

**Gives back:** true when sent.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.setGimbal", new { pan = 30, pitch = -10, speed = 40 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_set_gimbal(pan=30, pitch=-10, speed=40)
    ```

## obsbot.setZoom

Zooms your OBSBOT camera in or out.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zoom` | `zoom` | How far to zoom, 0 (all the way out) to 100 (all the way in). |
| `device` | `device` | Optional. Which camera in OBSBOT Center, 1 to 4. Leave it out for the selected one. |

**Gives back:** true when sent.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.setZoom", new { zoom = 50 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_set_zoom(zoom=50)
    ```

## obsbot.triggerPreset

Moves your OBSBOT camera to one of its saved positions (presets).

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `preset` | Optional. Which preset, 1 to 3. Default 1. |
| `device` | `device` | Optional. Which camera in OBSBOT Center, 1 to 4. Leave it out for the selected one. |

**Gives back:** true when sent.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("obsbot.triggerPreset", new { preset = 2 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.obsbot_trigger_preset(preset=2)
    ```
